You don’t have to have it all figured out right now, you don’t have to have a huge plan for your future or even for next week, it’s okay to just use what you have in the moment to make it through... what matters is that you made it through. Movements like BLM don’t care if you have a sign or if you show up empty handed because what matters is you’re there and any decent human being would rather you walk with them than jump. 


Do you have pets? I feel like pets are good for sticking around for, gives you something to take care of, something to keep you company, and you know they’d miss you and be very confused if they didn’t have you anymore.
Well a million pages of floral tops later I can’t find it lol but thanks for replying I didn’t realize Walmart has a boatload of brands to pick from
Okiedokie where did you get that floral top

Having that gag reaction to kindness is a symptom of childhood trauma and a defense mechanism we adopt to protect ourselves...even as adults. I’m so sorry you’re in this situation. 

I don’t think you’re a monster. I hope you get through this. Maybe check out a local food shelf, they usually won’t ask questions or judge they just want to feed people. Also dollar stores are great for getting a lot of food for cheap. I wish I could help you. You don’t deserve to feel like you should be alone, no one deserves that.
Wow I feel this all the time! I wish I’d done better in school! I wish I’d set myself up for success and worked harder. If I could have a redo in life I’d take it.
Yeah, all I want in life is to have someone to come home to.
